redacted.$comment: mirrored from redacted.schema.json; identity-checked by the validator
redacted.description: Typed Redacted(reason, commitment) stub (plan §4.5). Mirrors redacted.schema.json; inlined to keep this file self-contained.

commitment.description: Content commitment (hash) of the redacted original.

original_class.description: Artifact class of the redacted original (plan §4.4 prefix, e.g. crash, ctx, proof).

allOf.description: The lean block is required only for Lean-flavored certificates; kernel-checked SAT/closed-set certificates are Lean-free (plan §20).

schema_id.description: Artifact-class identity of the governing schema: its `$id` with the `v<schema_epoch>/` segment removed (schemas/README.md). Stable across schema epochs.

schema_epoch.description: Schema epoch this instance was written against (schemas/README.md). It advances only on a breaking change to this artifact class, is not one of the six independently versioned epochs (RFC 0026 `rule versioning.epoch_independence`), and pins no semantics.

assurance_class.description: docs/03 §7 'Solver trust classes' / ADR-0017, verbatim: whether this verified claim rests on evidence the checker fully re-derived (`CHECKED_CERTIFICATE`, docs/03 §3's 'small kernel checked evidence') or still leans on at least one unchecked solver-produced fact (`TRUSTED_SOLVER`). RFC 0005 'Proof-producing solver policy' forbids a bare "verified" that does not expose this alongside `trusted_components`.

trusted_components.description: docs/03 §2's `trusted: Vec<TrustedComponent>`: the named facts this checker structurally could not re-derive from the certificate's own bytes and therefore still trusts (e.g. the certificate-model correspondence, an envelope digest binding, or a specific theory lemma a solver supplied). Empty only for a checker with nothing left to trust beyond the encoding itself.

kind.description: Certificate family (RFC 0005 'Certificate families'). `state-type` is the state-typing half of `closed-set`'s family (docs/16 PO-MOD-003): a table-membership obligation with no transition relation, checked by the same closed-reachable-set family but previously indistinguishable from `closed-set` outside prose.

toolchain.description: Toolchain identity that produced the checker build (INV-014: build digest and toolchain identity).

axiom_manifest.description: Structured axiom manifest referenced alongside lean.axioms.

redactions.description: Redacted values referenced by this receipt (plan §4.5, §18.4).
